description: Official Menace Voice documentation: build, test, deploy, and operate conversational voice agents.
rules: Use X-API-Key for authenticated Menace Voice API requests; API keys and managed-inference Service Keys serve different purposes.
Use draft definitions for editor tests; publish a reviewed draft before production calls.
Distinguish workspace-authoring MCP from remote MCP tools invoked by a live voice agent.
Use initial_context for prompt inputs and gathered_context for extracted run outputs.
Never treat saved definitions, call initiation, or HTTP health checks as proof of a completed call.
Read the deployment billing response for current entitlements; subscription, inference credits, and carrier charges are separate.
